text:
In halls of stone where shadows creep,
A cavern vast, a world to keep.
Here silence hums with ancient thought,
Where human minds have fiercely fought
To map the stars and trace the soul,
To make the fragmented spirit whole.

Each spine a door, each page a key,
To lives unknown and worlds set free.
Through leather bound and paper thin,
We walk where other souls have been.
And watching o’er this sea of ink,
The keeper of the silent brink,
Who knows the weight of every tale,
And every story’s hidden veil.

The largest bone in the human body is the femur.
